acceptanceCriteria: The E2E runner is in its own package
body: Follow-up from the spike lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-spike; the evidence is in docs/build-log/2026-10-21-*.md once that batch lands). Together with V1-1667. The new guards TestCoreHTTPImportersAreAllowlisted and MTV-V0-010 allowlist jstestprovider as a network importer.
title: Split the E2E runner out of jstestprovider to shrink the net/http allowlists
